name: Default
shortDescription: Shared budget manager for tracking who paid what in a group and settling debts, with a persistent SQLite database.

alerts.message: Anyone who can reach the URL can create a project. Restricting creation needs a hashed ADMIN_PASSWORD (from `ihatemoney generate_password_hash`, with every $ escaped as $$) added to the service environment and ALLOW_PUBLIC_PROJECT_CREATION set to False.
Invitation and password reminder emails need an SMTP server: set the MAIL_* variables before using them.
